{{Quote|Please stand by for a priority communication from Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh of the Galactic Republic.|CC-9G|audio=CC-9G.flac|<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />}}
'''CC-9G''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who served [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" /> Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Year">{{TOR updates|2.0}} CC-9G appears in the intro to the ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'' storyline, setting their appearance around 3638 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> CC-9G contacted heroes of the Republic&mdash;each aboard their own personal [[Starship/Legends|ships]]&mdash;by [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]], to transmit a priority communication from Saresh. In the call, the Supreme Chancellor requested they travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], to help [[Conquest of Makeb|drive]] the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] off of the world.<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />

CC-9G was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with [[Color/Legends|blue-colored]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], and dark plating.<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />

==Behind the scenes==
CC-9G was featured in the [[2013]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by the company [[BioWare]]. The droid appears briefly as a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] in the main quest "Trouble in Paradise" for the Republic storyline, available to all classes of the faction.<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" /> According to the database of ''SWTOR'' game files on [[Jedipedia]], the model used for CC-9G possesses black plating.<ref name="Jedipedia">{{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/cc-9g|text=CC-9G|work=[[Jedipedia]]|archivedate=20200204160332}}</ref>
